_source: Three steel check templates of an engineering office, sheet «Hilfstabelle Stahl-Profile», «Ausschnitt C5 SZS»: the template's own extract of SZS C5, read with openpyxl on 12.10.2026 (307-ExcelTools). Every value in plain mm units. A CROSS-CHECK of calc/norms/szs-c5-2018-profile-*.json, never a source: where the two disagree the page of SZS C5 was read again and it wins (`disagreements`). A_v and A_w of the tubes and bars are left out: C5 prints none, the template computes them.

disagreements._note: Each entry: the template's value differs from the page by more than `rounding`, and why (checked on a 330-400 dpi render of the page).
disagreements.UPE * r: the template's r column holds t_f; the page's r is 10 to 18 mm (PDF p. 39)
disagreements.UPN 260 A_v: the template has 1710, the page 2710 (PDF p. 40)
disagreements.L * i_y: for the unequal angles the template's i_y column holds e_y (PDF p. 56)
disagreements.ROR 57x10 A: the template has 1418, the page 1477 = pi/4 (57² - 37²) (PDF p. 64)
disagreements.ROR 711x10 i_y: the template took U_t, 12,9 m²/t; the page's i is 248 (PDF p. 67)
disagreements.ROR 813x10 i_y: the template took U_t; the page's i is 284 (PDF p. 67)
disagreements.HEB 100 W_el_z: the template has 33, the page 33,5 (PDF p. 44)

absent._note: Rows of the templates SZS C5:2018 does not tabulate: IPE 750x137 (the book lists 750x134, PDF p. 34) and ROR sizes its overview (pp. 58-59) gives a mass for and no static value -- the templates computed them. Not compared.

renamed._note: The templates name HL by series letter (and «HL 1000x» for 1000 AA) and RRW 350x350x12.5 as 350x350x12; written here as the tables key them (h x m; the page's thickness).
